usedFor: Speak AI analyzes audio and video, Hastewire makes text sound natural, and “Media Analyzed” can start “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “Media Analyzed” in Speak AI, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: It fires once media is analyzed, so each finished analysis can be followed by text made to sound natural.

watchOut: “Events Updated” and “New Events Created” in Speak AI are polling, while “Media Analyzed” is pushed.
